### If this is an option deadline instead

Show the option amount, holder, exercise deadline, exercise method and the verified consequences of exercise/non-exercise. A **player option** offers the player's eligible choices; a **team option** shows the club's decision. A deadline passing follows the applicable terms, not an invented default. Remove the negotiation menu if no new offer exists.
